scope: teacher-local-clock proxy / conditional km teaching model; no claim of real taxi data or economic optimum
selection_data: first70percent dates inner-train + held-out inner-validation; no heldouttest metrics accessed
evidence: movement_trainseed_confirmation_v1 five training seeds x five common validation simulations; beta_validation_v1; double_v2_rngfix; fusion_validation_v1
decision: KM immediate-fare edge weighting + learnedV-guided neighbor movement with lambda3 penalty is selected gross-revenue candidate; preserve QKM+same movement as parent tradeoff and lambda5 as low-empty-distance sensitivity
guard: mean response >= same teacher QKM-.01; gross revenue and empty distance reported separately; hypothetical1currency/km diagnostic is not the primary objective
rollback: LT edge weighting removed in selected movement candidate because it reduced gross revenue in all five training seeds; learnedV still used for movement
not_adopted: Double beta1 increases revenue relative to beta1Q but lowers response and does not beat beta.5 reference; retain as teacher-required evaluated mechanism
NSGA knee/constraint reduce pickup but lose revenue/response; retain Pareto tradeoff, do not claim dominance
Patience3 changes customer waiting contract and stays sensitivity; gamma/grid changes not sufficiently supported for replacing teacher reference
Naive zero-penaltyV movement incurs excessive emptydistance; retain negative result

followup_models: full70 Q beta1 and Double beta1 trainseed2024; paired5 final simulated days; development had5 independent training seeds
